AIFIELD / EXAMPLES & VALIDATION

Engineering evidence, with its context intact.

AIFIELD’s September 2026 material includes internal comparisons and a photonic glucose chip-design example. These illustrate design and simulation work. They are not external customer case studies or fabricated-device measurements.

Conceptual illustration · not a product image or measured result
A photonic glucose chip-design example

The engineering question connects an optical sensing objective to a photonic design. AIFIELD contributes the design and simulation workflow; the intended measurement belongs to ArtiSense. A design output is useful evidence of engineering activity, while physical sensing remains a separate validation task.

Research & validation
Reading the evidence record
Evidence area	Supplied context	Boundary
Worked design	Photonic glucose chip-design example	Design activity, not sensing validation
Classical simulation	Internal comparisons described in September 2026	Reference, conditions and misses need publication review
Assisted workflow	Command-line and MCP interactions	Partial assistance with human review
Neural prediction	Research experiments with supplied boundary information	Generalization and practical speed remain open
A benchmark is more than a number

A publishable comparison needs the reference tool or method, geometry, materials, boundary conditions, numerical settings, evaluation measure, runtime environment and date. It must include misses as well as successes. No unsupported accuracy or acceleration figure is added to this draft.

Make the next result reproducible

A proposed next milestone is a reviewable demonstration and evidence package: design inputs, relevant settings, outputs and interpretation. The project team needs to confirm the scope and release permissions before those materials can be shared.
